definitions.confirmed: def.conf != null && def.conf.claim.mandateHash == eng.mandateId && def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut && amt(def.conf.claim.total.value, 'RLUSD') == def.booked && def.deposit <= amt(mandate.constraints.maxDeposit.value, 'RLUSD')
definitions.checkedIn: def.conf != null && att.list('party.checkin/1', 'counterparty').exists(c, c.claim.status == 'checked_in') && def.balance >= def.booked + def.deposit
definitions.disputeOpen: ledger.credentialExists(eng.parties.principal, eng.account, 'ENG/DISPUTE') && size(def.disputes) > 0 && def.balance >= def.booked + (def.checkedIn && !def.disputes.exists(d, d.claim.phase == 'entry') ? def.deposit : zero('RLUSD')) + amt(params.minDisputeBond, 'RLUSD')
definitions.conceded: def.entryDispute && att.list('party.concession/1', 'counterparty').exists(c, def.disputes.exists(d, d.claim.phase == 'entry' && d.id == c.claim.disputeRef))
definitions.disputeOpenedAt: size(def.settlementDisputes) > 0 ? (timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy) ? timestamp(def.settlementDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.deliveryBy)) : size(def.stayDisputes) > 0 ? (timestamp(def.stayDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn) ? timestamp(def.stayDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn)) : (timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) > timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn) ? timestamp(def.entryDisputes[0].issuedAt) : timestamp(eng.timers.checkIn))
definitions.arbiterRulings: size(def.disputes) > 0 ? att.list('party.ruling/1', 'arbiter').filter(r, timestamp(r.issuedAt) >= def.disputeOpenedAt) : def.claim != null ? att.list('party.ruling/1', 'arbiter').filter(r, timestamp(r.issuedAt) >= timestamp(def.claim.issuedAt)) : []

rules.title: Confirms the guest's actual booking
rules.message: The hotel's confirmation must point to the guest's own booking request.

rules.title: Right city and dates
rules.check: def.conf.claim.city == mandate.constraints.city && def.conf.claim.checkIn == mandate.constraints.checkIn && def.conf.claim.checkOut == mandate.constraints.checkOut
rules.message: The confirmed city and check-in/check-out dates must match what the guest asked for.

rules.title: Right price
rules.message: The confirmed total must equal the room price the guest paid in.

rules.title: Deposit within the guest's limit
rules.message: The security deposit the hotel asks for must not exceed the maximum the guest agreed to. Otherwise the confirmation doesn't count.

rules.title: Guest checked in
rules.message: The hotel has recorded the guest's arrival (once recorded, a check-in can't be taken back), and the deposit is in the account.

rules.title: Deposit is exactly right
rules.message: The account holds the room price plus exactly the confirmed deposit, no more, no less.

rules.title: Valid settlement
rules.message: An agreed settlement splits the money between guest and hotel and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of whatever the hotel receives. Refunds to the guest carry no fee.

rules.title: Guest left a review
rules.message: A stay that happened settles together with the guest's review, so every completed booking leaves a reputation record.

rules.title: Pays only guest, hotel and fee
rules.message: A settlement can only pay the guest, the hotel, and the service fee, never the arbiters or anyone else.

rules.title: Hotel admitted the problem
rules.message: There must be an open check-in dispute from the guest, and the hotel's own statement conceding it.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: A conceded refund sends everything to the guest and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Full refund
rules.message: Everything in the account goes back to the guest, including any deposit and the dispute bond, with no fee.

rules.title: Refund is due
rules.message: The automatic refund is only for a booking the hotel never confirmed by its deadline. If the hotel confirmed in time, it doesn't apply.

rules.title: The room price is in the account
rules.message: The refund needs at least the room price in the account. Anything more (a stray payment, a deposit) is not a reason to stall: it goes back to the guest too.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: The automatic refund pays the guest back and closes the account.

rules.title: Everything goes back to the guest
rules.message: The guest gets back every last cent in the account, the room price plus anything extra, with no fee.

rules.title: No-show is due
rules.message: A no-show only counts after the last check-in time and after the guest's window to dispute at check-in has closed.

rules.title: Booking was confirmed
rules.message: Only a confirmed booking can end in a no-show. An unconfirmed one ends in a refund instead.

rules.title: Guest never checked in
rules.message: If the hotel recorded the guest as checked in and the deposit is in, it isn't a no-show. A recorded check-in is final: a later 'refused' doesn't undo it.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: If the guest filed a dispute (with its bond), the automatic endings wait for the arbiter. Silence can't override a raised flag.

rules.title: The room price is in the account
rules.message: The no-show needs at least the room price in the account. Anything more (a partial deposit, a stray payment) does not stop it: it goes back to the guest.

rules.title: Valid no-show payout
rules.message: The no-show ending pays the room to the hotel (less the fee), returns anything extra to the guest, and closes the account.

rules.title: Correct service fee
rules.message: The service takes 0.5% of the room price the hotel receives. Money returned to the guest carries no fee.

rules.title: Hotel gets the room, the guest gets any extra
rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked && def.toGuest + def.booked == def.balance && tx.payouts.hasResidual() == (def.balance > def.booked)
rules.message: The hotel is paid exactly the room price (less the fee). Anything else in the account, such as a partial deposit, goes back to the guest. Of the two no-show endings signed in advance, only the one that fits the money actually in the account can be used.

rules.title: Release is due
rules.message: The 'nobody acted' release only fires after the guest's window to dispute has closed, and only for a stay that happened.

rules.title: No open dispute
rules.message: If the guest filed a dispute (with its bond), the release waits for the arbiter. Silence can't override a raised flag.

rules.title: Room and deposit are in the account
rules.message: The release needs at least the room plus the deposit in the account. Anything more (a stray payment) does not stop it: it goes back to the guest.

rules.title: Valid release
rules.message: The release pays the room to the hotel, returns the deposit and anything extra to the guest, and closes the account.

rules.title: No deposit claim standing
rules.check: def.claim == null || (now > timestamp(eng.timers.disputeWindowEnds) + def.rulingWindow && !def.disputeOpen && def.arbiterRuling == null)
rules.message: If the hotel claimed against the deposit, the release can't just return it: the claim has to be agreed, or ruled on. But the hotel must make its case: if the guest has no open (bonded) dispute and the arbiter hasn't ruled on the claim by the ruling deadline (counted from the end of the guest's dispute window), the claim lapses and the deposit goes back to the guest.

rules.title: Deposit and any extra go back in full
rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked && def.toGuest + def.booked == def.balance && def.toGuest >= def.deposit && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The hotel gets the room price less the fee; the whole deposit, plus anything else in the account, returns to the guest.

rules.title: Arbiter missed its deadline on an arrival dispute
rules.message: Only for a confirmed booking with the guest's one open, bonded dispute about a problem on arrival (no room, wrong room), once the arbiter's ruling deadline, counted from the dispute, has passed. Whether it is an arrival dispute is fixed when it is filed, so later payments into the account can't change the outcome. An unconfirmed booking is refunded instead.

rules.title: Arbiter hasn't ruled
rules.message: Once the arbiter's ruling is on record (received by the co-signer), the automatic default never applies: the arbiter and the winning party close the deal instead.

rules.title: Valid refund
rules.message: The entry chargeback pays the guest back and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Everything goes back to the guest
rules.message: Like a card chargeback, the guest gets back everything in the account: the room price, any deposit and the dispute bond, with no fee.

rules.title: Arbiter missed its deadline on a claim or stay dispute
rules.check: def.checkedIn && size(def.disputes) == 1 && def.rulingDue && (size(def.settlementDisputes) == 1 || (def.stayDispute != null && def.stayNight >= eng.terms.nights))
rules.message: Only for a stay that happened, with the guest's one open, bonded dispute filed after checkout (against the hotel's claim or the stay) or in the stay's last night, once the arbiter's ruling deadline has passed.

rules.title: Arbiter hasn't ruled
rules.message: Once the arbiter's ruling is on record (received by the co-signer), the automatic default never applies: the arbiter and the winning party close the deal instead.

rules.title: Valid payout
rules.message: The claim chargeback pays the hotel, the fee and the guest, and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Hotel gets the room, nothing more
rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The hotel's claim is rejected: the hotel is paid exactly the room price, less the service's 0.5% fee.

rules.title: Everything else goes back to the guest
rules.check: tx.payouts.items.exists(p, p.partial && p.to == eng.parties.principal) && tx.payouts.items.all(p, !p.partial || p.to == eng.parties.principal) && def.toGuest + def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.balance
rules.message: The guest's payment is the one that sweeps up whatever is left: the whole deposit, the dispute bond and anything extra.

rules.title: Arbiter missed its deadline on a mid-stay dispute
rules.check: def.checkedIn && size(def.disputes) == 1 && def.stayDispute != null && def.rulingDue && def.stayNight < eng.terms.nights && eng.terms.nights <= params.maxStayVariantNights
rules.message: Only for the guest's one open, bonded dispute filed during the stay, before its last night, once the arbiter's ruling deadline has passed. Stays longer than 14 nights have no such ending: the dispute waits for the arbiter.

rules.title: Arbiter hasn't ruled
rules.message: Once the arbiter's ruling is on record (received by the co-signer), the automatic default never applies: the arbiter and the winning party close the deal instead.

rules.title: Valid payout
rules.message: The stay chargeback pays the hotel, the fee and the guest, and closes the account, in one transaction.

rules.title: Hotel gets only the nights used
rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.nightly * def.stayNight && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The hotel is paid for the nights up to and including the one in which the guest disputed (each night's share of the room price), less the service's 0.5% fee. A night counts once it has begun, from the scheduled check-in time. Of the per-night versions signed in advance, only the one for that night can be used.

rules.title: Everything else goes back to the guest
rules.check: tx.payouts.items.exists(p, p.partial && p.to == eng.parties.principal) && tx.payouts.items.all(p, !p.partial || p.to == eng.parties.principal) && def.toGuest + def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.balance
rules.message: The guest's payment is the one that sweeps up whatever is left: the remaining nights, the whole deposit, the dispute bond and anything extra.

rules.title: Hotel posted a claim
rules.message: A default ruling only exists to settle a deposit claim the guest never answered.

rules.title: Guest didn't dispute
rules.message: If the guest disputed the claim, the arbiter rules on the dispute instead.

rules.title: Guest's time to answer is over
rules.message: The guest can dispute a claim until the dispute window closes. Only after that does an unanswered claim stand.

rules.title: Claim within the deposit
rules.message: A claim can never exceed the security deposit.

rules.title: Pays exactly the claim
rules.check: def.toMerchant + def.toFee == def.booked + def.claimTotal && def.toGuest == def.deposit - def.claimTotal && def.toFee == bps(def.toMerchant + def.toFee, params.serviceFeeBps)
rules.message: The hotel gets the room plus the claim (less the fee); the rest of the deposit goes back to the guest.
